# ARTIDOM — Custom Furniture Workshop in Montenegro

> Custom kitchens, wardrobes and apartment furnishing. Workshop in Bar, serving all of Montenegro.

- [Homepage (EN)](https://artidom.art/en): Custom kitchens and apartment furnishing in Montenegro
- [Homepage (SR)](https://artidom.art/sr): Kuhinje po mjeri i namještaj u Crnoj Gori

- [Projects](https://artidom.art/en/projects): Portfolio of completed residential and HoReCa projects

- [HoReCa](https://artidom.art/en/solutions/horeca): Restaurant, hotel and hospitality furniture
- [Workspace](https://artidom.art/en/solutions/workspace): Office and clinic furniture
- [Education](https://artidom.art/en/solutions/education): School and public space furniture
